name: @vaipakam/failed-tx-pass
description: The failed transaction pass (#3919): finds failed transactions sent to the platform's contracts, decodes them while the node still holds the state, and writes them through the indexer's /internal/failed-tx route. Runs on the keeper machine as its own unit, with no signing key and no database binding.

scripts.build: esbuild host/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/failed-tx-pass.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
